title: Card Intelligence Forum Policy
purpose: Every card deep-dive page has a mini forum/intake panel where users can submit public-record leads, links, corrections and context for that exact card.
boundary: Submissions are leads, not verified facts. Nothing submitted by a user becomes a site claim until reviewed, sourced, classified and evidence-rated.
nextImplementation: Wire profile pages to submit to a Worker route such as /submit-card-intel and store approved leads in data/card-intel-submissions.json or a database-backed queue.
